 This application coming on for hearing this day, the court passed the
following:
 Order
This is first bail application u/S.439 Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail.
Applicant has been arrested on 18.03.2023 by Police Station -Civil Lines, District Datia (M.P.) in connection with Crime No.149/2023 for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 506, 120(B) of IPC.

In brief, the prosecution case is that on 18.03.2023 10 AM complainant prosecutrix a married lady aged about 22 years lodged a computerized F.I.R.

1 against present applicant/accused that she resides at Imlipura, Datia.

sentences.text: Ten days back, her husband had gone to Haryana for doing business of Tikki, on 17.03.2023, her friend Rinki with called her in the hospital to take care of her.

On her request, she along with her son had gone to district hospital,
Datia.
Thereafter, her friend Rinki had a talk with present applicant/accused on phone.
She took her to Tigoliya, where present applicant/accused met her.
He took them to the house of Gallamandi.
He took her in his house.
The mother of friend had gone to sleep in her room.
In room Rinki, present applicant/accused and the prosecutrix was there.
After put off her clothes, present applicant accused committed rape with her.
When she cried, her son woke up and mother of her friend Rinki came there.
He threatened her with dare consequences.
On her report, a crime was registered as aforesaid.
Applicant/accused and friend of prosecutrix were arrested.
She was sent for medical examination.
No adverse report has been arrived on medical examination.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and falsely implicated in the case.
He is in custody since 18.03.2023.
Conclusion o f trial will take time.

On such premises,
learned counsel for the applicant prayed for bail.
Learned counsel for the State opposed the application and submits that applicant is having four criminal cases and prayed for its rejection.
However, learned counsel for the complainant vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed that condition may be imposed on the applicant while granting bail to him.
Heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the case diary.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of this case but without commenting upon the merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if the applicant furnishes cash security of Rs.25,000/- (Twenty Five Thousand only) alongwith bail bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rs. Twenty Five thousand only) before the trial Court, he should be released on bail.
The applicant shall also abide by all other conditions as enumerated in Section 437 of Cr. P. C.
He will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
In case of any default, cash security of Rs.25,000/- shall be forfeited without giving him any notice.

Application stands allowed and disposed of.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DEEPAK KUMAR AGARWAL) JUDGE mani SUBASRI MANI 2023.04.21 18:32:49 -07'00'
